findings.evidence: SOURCE 1 and SOURCE 2 contain no published release identifier for this board; leaderboard.json metadata has only last_updated and total_tasks, and the page text offers no version string. Criterion c2 requires `version_status: published` only when the maintainer publishes a release identifier and `version` copies it. With no such identifier, the correct lifecycle status is `snapshot` and the row’s version should be a dated snapshot identity, not `published` with an internal id like `opt1-102`.
findings.repair: Change `version_status` to `snapshot` and set `version` to `snapshot-2026-10-03` (or the frozen observation date), unless a maintainer-published release identifier is identified.

uncertainties: This is a read-only review; owner-executed SHA-256/hash and transport/qualification checks were not independently re-run. c1 checks (identity, metric, units, description, task count, served scale) otherwise match the captured protocol and payload.
